page.overview:
Who is Unidentified Duros Council member?

A Duros Jedi Master of the Jedi Order was a member of the Jedi High Council during the High Republic Era. the Jedi was present when Porter Engle informed the Council that Barash Silvain took a vow to distance herself from the Jedi Order to find out what the Force wanted her to do.
